targets.approach: The Bridge Group lies in the Menagerie Wilderness off Highway 20 near Santiam Pass. Take Moose Mountain Road (Road 2027) to forest roads 850 or 857 and then 856, and continue on foot as far as the road system allows. A trail drops from the end of the roads down to the Bridge Group formation, where the route is found.
targets.name: Butterfly Buttress

targets.approach: The Bridge Group lies in the Menagerie Wilderness off Highway 20 near Santiam Pass, reached by Moose Mountain Road (Road 2027), forest roads 850/857 and 856 and then a trail down to the formation. Electric Ladyland is on the underside of the Bridge formation and starts from the saddle beneath it, which has a two-bolt anchor. Either scramble to the saddle from the south base of the gully or rappel in from the top of the Bridge.
targets.name: Electric Ladyland

targets.approach: The Bridge Group lies in the Menagerie Wilderness off Highway 20 near Santiam Pass, reached by Moose Mountain Road (Road 2027), forest roads 850/857 and 856 and then a trail down to the formation. The Newt Route starts beside the large tree at the west end of the south leg of the bridge, on the uphill side.
targets.descent_text: Cross back over the bridge from the summit and scramble down to the saddle on the uphill side.
targets.name: The Newt Route

targets.approach: Park at the Rooster Rock trailhead and take the steep trail up to Rooster Rock, going right at the fork. Below Rooster Rock, climbers' trails descend through scree to its base and on beneath Hen Rock. Chicken Rock is just west of Hen Rock and shows up on your right as you go beneath Hen. Rawhide starts on the northeast side, between the chicken and the hen, and traverses beneath Sticky Fingers and Free Bird.
targets.descent_text: Chicken Rock is descended by a rappel from the top.
targets.name: Rawhide

targets.approach: Park as for Britt Nichols Park, walk the spur road to its end and take the well-defined trail on the left downhill to the top of Scorpion Buttress. From the top of Scorpion Butte either rappel into West Gully or follow the steep switchbacking trail on the right to the middle of the gully. Gym Wall is on the left heading down, and the route begins in the gully above the tree on its right side; belay from the tree.
targets.name: Gym Crack

targets.approach: Park at the Rooster Rock trailhead and take the steep trail up to Rooster Rock, going right at the fork. Below Rooster Rock, climbers' trails descend through scree to its base and on beneath Hen Rock. Hen Rock sits between Chicken Rock and Rooster Rock, and Winter Sunshine is on the right side of its south face.
targets.descent_text: Descent is a rappel down the north face from rings at the top.
targets.name: Winter Sunshine

targets.approach: Follow the approach to West Gully and the Gym Wall, by the trail from the top of Scorpion Buttress or by rappelling in. At the bottom of the gully the Prayer Wall faces the Gym Wall. The small madrone tree hung with prayer flags marks the base, and it also marks the start of Madrone Crack.
targets.name: Madrone Crack

targets.approach: Park at the Rooster Rock trailhead and take the steep trail up to Rooster Rock, going right at the fork. Below Rooster Rock, climbers' trails descend through scree to its base and on beneath Hen Rock. Rooster Rock is the first pinnacle reached off the trail. The route starts on the big flake at the foot of the north face.
targets.descent_text: Rap rings at the top of the north face provide the way down.
targets.name: Two Legged Dinosaur Observes Sanik the Flying Ravioli

targets.approach: From Anthony Lake follow the Hoffer Lakes Trail to the upper Hoffer Lake. The Upper and Lower Walls are in the little valley that runs southwest from the lake: scramble around the slabs on the south side to a meadow, then follow the faint trail past the Lower Wall and steeply on along the base of the escarpment to the Upper Wall. North Flake starts in a corner and follows the flake. The anchors are on the big ledge at the top, set well back from the edge.
targets.name: North Flake

targets.approach: From Anthony Lake follow the Hoffer Lakes Trail to the upper Hoffer Lake. The Upper and Lower Walls are in the little valley that runs southwest from the lake: scramble around the slabs on the south side to a meadow, then follow the faint trail past the Lower Wall and steeply on along the base of the escarpment to the Upper Wall. Wide Bottom is the crack system at the left end of the face, and it exits right to the anchor above Chisel Queen.
targets.name: Wide Bottom
